caption: The offer editor of UpsellPlus in the Shopify admin for the draft Smart cross-sell, with the Where choice Cart Drawer selected and the Incentive choice 10% off selected, the lines Products (chosen automatically for each cart), Who sees it (every shopper) and Store setup (the cart drawer upsell still needs adding), and on the right a Preview with the note that real products from the store are shown and picked by AI at runtime: The Inventory Not Tracked Snowboard at $854.95 (was $949.95) and Gift Card at $9.00 (was $10.00), each with an Add to Cart button. Below it a box Place your app block marked Incomplete. A bar says Unsaved changes with Discard and Save, and nothing was saved. The store name and avatar at the bottom of the left menu are covered.

The Billing page of UpsellPlus: a box Development store (you have full access to every feature, free; development, partner and Shopify staff stores are never charged) and a table How pricing works with nine steps by upsell revenue: Basic up to $500 at $49 a month, Pro up to $2,000 at $119, Advanced up to $5,000 at $199, Scale 1 up to $10,000 at $299, Scale 2 up to $15,000 at $399, Scale 3 up to $20,000 at $499, Scale 4 up to $30,000 at $699, Scale 5 up to $40,000 at $799 and Unlimited at $999 a month.

The same Billing page with the pricing steps hidden: the box Development store with the text that this store has full access to every feature for free and that a store on a paid Shopify plan starts on the free plan and then follows the pricing steps, the line Your price follows the upsell revenue UpsellPlus generates for you, a Show all steps button and the line All prices are in USD, charges will appear on your Shopify invoice.
